title: Whose House Is This?
hook: Rumi asks a strange question about a house full of music.

segments.fa: این خانه که پیوسته در او بانگ چغانه‌ست
segments.en: This house, where the lute never stops playing,

segments.fa: از خواجه بپرسید که این خانه چه خانه‌ست
segments.en: ask its master: what house is this?

tafsir: The music never stops in this house.
So Rumi says: do not guess. Ask the master who lives here.
One reading: the house is the heart.
And the master is the one who lives inside it.
This week in our serial, Rumi searches far for Shams, and finds him close.

outro.say: Shams and Rumi, the serial, is on our page. Follow The Guest House.
